policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 31 Mar close (1x4 3.85, 3x6 4.03, 6x9 4.31, 9x12 4.50 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 65bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar (a 'hawkish cut'); the 8-9 Apr meeting is expected to hold. Dąbrowski (26 Mar): the MPC leans to holding rather than hiking; Tyrowicz (24 Mar) sees 4.75% as appropriate. March flash CPI 3.0% (31 Mar; 3.3% expected); core 2.5% in February. The fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise) takes ~0.9pp off April CPI (ING, PKO).
policy.risk_text: War and oil set the direction: FRAs price NBP hikes the MPC says it does not plan; escalation would lift the front end further, a ceasefire would unwind hike pricing. Long end: global term premia (Bund ~3%) and the fiscal cost of the fuel shield.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026 (Inflation Report, 6 Mar). The next projection comes in July.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP (MoF figures in Fitch); 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after February PLN 48.5bn; fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) from 27-31 Mar.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~41% (end-Q1) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 167bn at end-March (MoF estimate). No rating action in April; S&P reviews Poland on 8 May (A-, stable); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar (next MPC 8-9 Apr); March CPI 3.0% y/y; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 31 Mar: March flash CPI 3.0% y/y (3.3% expected; fuels +15.4% m/m); MoF's April plan has sales on 15, 23 and 28 Apr (PLN 4-12bn, 6-14bn, 5-13bn; new 10Y DS0436 from 23 Apr), a 10 Apr 50-week T-bill and no switch; the Q2 plan has 7-8 sales for PLN 50-90bn; non-residents bought PLN 7.0bn of POLGBs in February (12.7% share); POLGB yields fell 6-8bp after the 10Y neared 6% on 30 Mar. Abroad: euro-area flash HICP 2.5% in March (core 2.3%); at least two ECB and two BoE hikes priced for 2026 (~50% for April); Brent rose a record ~50% in March; Bund 10Y ~3.0%, UST 10Y 4.33%.

calendar.plan_text: MoF April plan (31 Mar): sale auctions on 15 Apr (PLN 4-12bn; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1035, NZ0936), 23 Apr (6-14bn) and 28 Apr (5-13bn; new 10Y DS0436 replaces DS1035 from 23 Apr); no switch; a 50-week T-bill on 10 Apr (3-6bn). Q2 plan: 7-8 sales for PLN 50-90bn and 1-2 switches. 2026 needs ~41% financed at end-Q1.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it. April is back to regular supply: remaining sales 15 Apr, 23 Apr, 28 Apr. MPC 8-9 Apr: a hold is expected.

core_text: Regime: war shock - oil above $100 and core yields near multi-year highs; the NBP is at 3.75% after the March cut while FRAs price roughly 65bp of NBP hikes; the ECB and BoE are priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 64bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 290bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 31 Mar close). Euro-area HICP 2.5%; Brent +~50% in March (31 Mar).
